comment: Bun releases whose Postgres client mixes, drops or stalls pipelined requests under load (W12e; fixed upstream by oven-sh/bun#32088 and #43187, after 1.4.2). On these, Bun.SQL runs only with BUN_FEATURE_FLAG_DISABLE_SQL_AUTO_PIPELINING set at process start. fixedIn names the first release carrying both fixes, once one exists; src/db/bun-sql-pipelining.test.ts refuses a pin outside this list until it is set.
